init_hook: echo '║   � Docker SystemD Images Dev Environment       ║'
echo '    ⚠️  Make: Not available (install with your system package manager)'
echo '    make help               # Show all available targets'
echo '    make setup-dev          # Setup development environment'
echo '    make all               # Build all Docker images'
echo '    make debian-12         # Build Debian 12 image'
echo '    make oraclelinux-8     # Build Oracle Linux 8 image'
echo '    make lint-all          # Lint all files (Docker, YAML, MD)'
echo '    make test              # Test all built images'
echo '    make test-debian-12    # Test specific image'
echo '    make clean             # Remove built images'
echo '    make clean-dev         # Clean development environment'
echo '    make list              # List available images'
echo '    make sizes             # Show image sizes'
echo '  ✅ Docker is running and ready'
echo '  ⚠️  Docker found but daemon not running'
echo '     Please start Docker Desktop or Docker daemon'
echo '  ⚠️  Docker not found in PATH'
echo '     Devbox Docker package should be available'
echo '    devbox run setup-dev      # Setup development environment'
echo '    devbox run build-all      # Build all Docker images'
echo '    devbox run test-all       # Test all built images'
echo '    devbox run lint-all       # Run all linting checks'
echo '    devbox run quick-check    # Lint + build + test debian-12'
alias quick-check='make lint && make debian-12 && make test-debian-12'
